About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone for Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, procurement, billing and payroll services, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management to Stripe.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced finance professional to join the Accounts Payable team within Finance Operations at the Stripe Delivery Center (SDC). You’ll support accounts payable operations across Stripe’s US and international entities and build expertise in the end-to-end procure-to-pay process. Your work will include processing supplier invoices in Oracle, managing invoice backlogs, and resolving queries from suppliers and internal teams. You’ll partner with Procurement, Vendor Management, Payments, and Accounting to resolve issues and keep payments on track.

You’ll also lead cross-functional automation and process improvement projects to reduce manual work, improve invoice accuracy, shorten processing times, and make it easier for teams to track invoices and queries. As workflows change, you’ll update standard operating procedures and communicate those changes to the teams that rely on them.

Responsibilities

  • Own invoice processing and AP query management for US and international entities. Become a subject matter expert in the end-to-end procure-to-pay process and related activities.
  • Process a high volume of supplier invoices in Oracle. Validate invoice details and accounting coding, prioritize invoices by due date and urgency, and meet accuracy and turnaround targets.
  • Own supplier and internal AP queries from intake through resolution. Investigate invoice discrepancies, holds, potential duplicates, approval delays, and payment-status questions. Keep stakeholders informed and follow up until each issue is resolved.
  • Monitor aging invoices and backlogs. Escalate invoices at risk of missing payment deadlines and coordinate with Procurement, Vendor Management, and Payments to resolve issues.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and support accounting and operational activities.
  • Lead cross-functional automation and process improvement projects that reduce manual work, improve invoice processing accuracy and turnaround times, and give teams better visibility into invoice and query status.
  • Keep invoice processing and AP query workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs) up to date. Document changes and communicate them to the teams that use them.

Who you are

You understand the end-to-end procure-to-pay process and have hands-on experience processing a high volume of supplier invoices in Oracle or a comparable ERP. You manage competing deadlines and invoice backlogs without sacrificing accuracy, and you’ve owned supplier and internal AP queries from intake through resolution. You bring a strong accounting foundation, including general ledger processes, the chart of accounts, account coding, reconciliations, and month-end close. You exercise sound judgment and discretion, apply internal controls and compliance policies consistently, and know when to escalate an issue. You work independently in a fast-changing environment, communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and collaborate effectively across teams. You take a hands-on approach to solving problems, can lead automation and process improvement projects, and keep standard operating procedures up to date as workflows change.

Minimum requirements

  • 6–8 years of relevant accounts payable experience, preferably at a large multinational or global company, with hands-on experience processing high volumes of supplier invoices and resolving AP queries.
  • Strong understanding of accounting concepts, including accruals, prepayments, and the chart of accounts.
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience analyzing large datasets to investigate discrepancies and make sound decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to stay organized while managing competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with cross-functional teams and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and deliver accurate results with minimal supervision.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach to solving problems and improving processes.

You will also likely have (not required):

  • Experience working at a high-growth technology or financial services company
  • Experience with Oracle, Zip, or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP), accounting, or procurement systems.
  • knowledge on India TDS/GST/e-invoicing would be an add on.
descriptions.job-0rybpqm:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Millions of businesses across the internet run on Stripe. The Stripe Business Network team is building the B2B network that turns that scale into value for every one of them: a place where businesses discover and transact with each other, share verified data, and move money instantly and seamlessly.

We're building the experiences that make that network real. A single view of your entire Stripe network, including every platform, partner, and customer you do business with, where a new relationship is just a click away. Portable identity, so when you start working with a new platform, your verified business information comes with you instead of being collected from scratch. Closed-loop money movement, so paying another Stripe business is instant and costs a fraction of a card payment. A business directory where the right counterparties can find you. And trusted data sharing and profile representation, so counterparties have confidence in who they're working with.

Every business that joins makes the network more valuable for everyone already on it. We think of the Business Network as the business graph for the internet economy, and we're building for what's next.

What you'll do

You will build the Stripe Business Network experiences, including the Network Tab (a single page to see your whole Stripe network), search and discovery, profiles, networked invoicing, and much more, to deliver utility to our users across the board.

That means being a true champion of our users: end-to-end owner of core flows, a cross-functional partner to Engineering, Design, and GTM, and an active voice in shaping the Business Network's strategy alongside leadership. You'll define, build, and scale new and existing products, informed by user insights and data.

We're looking for a technical PM who operates with a high degree of autonomy and drive. You care deeply about craft and impact. The only thing that really matters to you is getting well-built products into users' hands. You're already exploring how AI is changing how products get built and what it means for the PM role; you might even have a few half-finished side projects that prove it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the user's perspective. Spend time with users, and synthesize their feedback and market signals into clear product direction.
  • Obsess over user impact rather than features shipped. Always ask (and quantify) how each release delivers value and utility to our users.
  • Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for adoption, user value, and business impact.
  • Own Stripe's strategic priorities. Use judgment to factor in Stripe's strategic positioning and leverage, and make network-accretive product choices.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ship cohesive, frictionless experiences.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency, high-paced product manager with strong craft to bring the next set of network features to life.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years in a product or technical role, with experience shipping world-class products at scale
  • High agency and an ownership mindset. You do whatever it takes to solve problems, delight users, and deliver business impact. You climb walls to get there.
  • High resilience and resourcefulness. You see around corners, think ahead, and find a way where there seemingly isn't one. You are highly proactive and able to set the pace for a team
  • High taste, design empathy, and sharp judgment. You put yourself in the shoes of users and are a steward of great experiences that deliver real utility.
  • Rigorous with data, including digging into metrics, getting to insight, telling a story with data, and thinking from first principles to deliver the right results
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a talent for distilling user problems into precise, actionable framing
  • Thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with complex payments or financial products, or building networks and marketplaces
  • Experience building brand-new products or working in a startup environment
  • Experience working with GTM teams to bring new products to market

About Polygon Labs

Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications.

Your Role

Polygon is building the Open Money Stack: one API for moving money anywhere and putting it to work. It's live, and the work spans US and international money movement.

A typical integration takes four to eight weeks. The path from contract to production is split across Sales, Compliance, Customer Success, and Engineering. Core product managers and engineers get pulled into enablement and troubleshooting. No one owns the hands-on integration work end to end. This role does.

You'll embed with a customer's product managers and engineers, write code next to them, and drive the integration live. You own the technical execution, from the pre-sales conversations to the first production transaction.

Then you work yourself out of the loop, so the next customer, or their AI, can integrate without asking anyone on our side.

Your Responsibilities

Embedded integration and delivery (the core of the job)

  • Own the path from contract to production: discovery, solution design, environment setup, API and webhook enablement, testing through UAT and failure modes, go-live sign-off, and first-transaction hypercare.

  • Embed with the customer's engineers, on-site if it moves the work faster, and hold them to milestones so weeks become days.

  • Integrate customers across the OMS APIs.

  • Handle the hard parts: key rotation, webhook signing, retries, idempotency, error handling, and reconciliation.

Pre-sales and solution design

  • Answer the technical questions on prospect calls with BD and in the follow-ups, going deeper than Sales or Product can. Then write the answer down in KB articles so nobody asks it again.

  • Lead discovery on legacy payments systems, fund flows, and compliance constraints, and write the integration plan we share early in the sale.

Keep core Engineering building

  • Triage partner issues yourself, with access to code, logs, and transaction data, so most never reach core Engineering.

  • When one is a real bug, bring Engineering a scoped ticket: reproduction, impact, logs, recommended fix.

Automate the integration path (out of the work, not instead of it)

  • Turn each bespoke integration into reusable assets: SDKs, runbooks, partner docs, and automation for the steps that repeat, like KYB intake, staging keys, and go-live gates.

  • Raise the API and integration docs and machine-readable specs to where a developer, or the customer's own AI coding agent, can integrate us without talking to anyone on our side.

  • Build the agents that answer partners' integration questions, so the same question is never answered twice.

Product and roadmap feedback

  • Bring Product and Engineering feedback grounded in demand across several customers, not one-off asks.

The reality of this role

We want this clear up front, because fit matters.

  • This is hands-on. You will write code every day. It is not a pre-sales-only or architecture-only seat, and not a coordinator seat: you solve the problem; you don't track it.

  • The stack is proprietary and parts of it are still being documented. You will often build the docs and tooling that don't exist yet.

  • Most partners are large, slow-moving organizations, many outside the US.

  • The stack changes weekly and nobody will hand you a plan. You should want that.
    What You'll Need

Responsibilities

  • Deep US payments rails experience: ACH pull and push, settlement windows, reconciliation, fund flows, money movement. This is the top thing we're hiring for. You don't need to have lived in the US.

  • 5+ years shipping production software, ideally payments. Forward deployed or implementation experience is ideal. A solutions engineer who codes is absolute the floor, not the target.

  • Hard integrations you shipped to production and can walk through, in at least one mainstream language (TypeScript, Python, Go, or similar). Not prototypes and slideware.

  • Comfortable embedding with a customer's team, working from incomplete docs (and helping complete them), and explaining the system to a developer and a CFO.

  • A reflex to automate. Once you've done a step twice, you build the tool, doc, or agent that removes it.

Technical profile and AI fluency

  • Hands-on with APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and authentication. You've built systems that scale and can read and contribute to a customer's codebase.

  • AI-native in how you work: AI coding tools for demos and middleware, AI for docs, and building agents as needs come up. Be ready to show it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Wallets, stablecoins, onchain payments, or crypto rails. We'll teach the crypto side to the right payments engineer.

  • Non-US rails and regulation (SPEI, PIX, SEPA, PSD2, SCA, Open Banking).

  • Compliance-driven design in regulated environments (KYB, KYC, transaction monitoring).

Polygon Labs Perks

The goal of the Polygon Labs total rewards program is to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our comprehensive compensation plan includes the following benefits for our full time employees:

  • Remote first global workforce

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental and Vision health insurance*

  • Company matching 401k with 3% match*

  • $1,500 Home Office Set Up Allowance (life-time max)

  • $200 Annual AI Allowance

  • $75 Monthly internet or phone reimbursement

  • Flexible Time Off

  • Company issued laptop

  • Egg freezing, mental health, and employee wellness benefits

*In certain countries medical, dental and vision is fully covered for employees & their dependents. This is country and plan specific.

*401k is for United States employees only

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Polygon Labs is committed to treating all people in a way that allows them to maintain their dignity and independence. We believe in integration and equal opportunity. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.

If you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the team and role

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.
